# ── Identity ───────────────────────────────────────────────

## Wondermayank

Wondermayank is a student developer from India who builds free online tools,
exam preparation simulators, movie and anime finders, study blogs and 70+
digital projects. Everything on this site is free with no sign-up required.

- Website: https://wondermayank.github.io/
- About page: https://wondermayank.github.io/about
- Contact (Telegram): https://t.me/Mindmaster_robot
- Telegram community: https://t.me/wondermayank
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@wondermayank
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/WONDERMAYANK
- Study Blog: https://commercesehoga.blogspot.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/wondermayank

# ── Tools & Projects ───────────────────────────────────────

## Finder Tools

- [Movie Finder](https://wondermayank.github.io/movie): Search Indian and international movies, get instant details and ratings.
- [Anime Finder](https://wondermayank.github.io/anime): Discover anime series powered by the Jikan API with full metadata.
- [Book Finder](https://wondermayank.github.io/books): Find books by title, author or genre.
- [Game](https://wondermayank.github.io/game): Free browser game for PC and mobile.

## Study & Exam Prep

- [CBT Mock Test](https://wondermayank.github.io/cbtmock): Free Computer-Based Test simulator for CUET, NEET, JEE, Banking (SBI, IBPS) and SSC exams.
- [CUET CBT](https://commercesehoga.github.io/dashboard): Dedicated CUET exam mock tests.
- [NEET-JEE CBT](https://commercesehoga.github.io/jee-neet): Mock tests for NEET and JEE aspirants.
- [Banking CBT](https://commercesehoga.github.io/banking): SBI, IBPS and banking exam simulators.
- [SSC CBT](https://commercesehoga.github.io/ssc): Staff Selection Commission exam simulator.
- [Book Hub](https://wondermayank.github.io/book): Organised educational books and structured study resources.
- [English Practice](https://wondermayank.github.io/cbtmock/english): Grammar, vocabulary and language tests.
- [General Aptitude Test](https://wondermayank.github.io/cbtmock/gat): Reasoning and awareness practice.
- [Current Affairs](https://wondermayank.github.io/Current_Affairs): Monthly, quarterly and yearly current affairs for all exams.
- [Periodic Table](https://wondermayank.github.io/Periodic-Table/v2/): Interactive chemistry periodic table explorer.
- [Hindi Typing](https://wondermayank.github.io/hindi): Learn and practise Hindi typing.
- [Main Study Blog](https://commercesehoga.blogspot.com): Structured notes and resources for commerce and exam prep students.
- [ThunderStudy Blog](https://thunderstudyofficial.blogspot.com): Additional study resources and notes.

## Creative & Utility Tools

- [Paletteify](https://wondermayank.github.io/paletteify): Free color palette generator for designers and developers.
- [Text to PDF](https://wondermayank.github.io/pdftotext): Convert plain text to professionally formatted PDFs.
- [Card Generator](https://wondermayank.github.io/card): Create digital greeting cards for weddings, birthdays and events with shareable links.
- [Help Tool](https://wondermayank.github.io/help): Daily helpers and quick reference utilities.

## India & Culture

- [India Overview](https://wondermayank.github.io/india): History, philosophy, geography and identity of India.
- [Festivals of India](https://wondermayank.github.io/india/festivals): Diwali, Holi, Eid, Pongal and more.
- [Indian Cuisine](https://wondermayank.github.io/india/cuisine): Spices, flavors and regional cuisines.
- [Languages of India](https://wondermayank.github.io/india/languages): Sanskrit, Tamil, Hindi, Bengali and India's 1,600+ languages.
- [Indian Art & Dance](https://wondermayank.github.io/india/art): Bharatanatyam, Madhubani painting and living heritage art forms.
- [History of India](https://wondermayank.github.io/india/history): Indus Valley to Independence — chronicles of empires and revolutions.
- [Kayastha](https://wondermayank.github.io/kayastha): History and cultural traditions of the Kayastha community.
- [Rajput](https://wondermayank.github.io/rajput): Valor and royal heritage of Rajput clans.
- [Explore All States](https://wondermayank.github.io/india/): Interactive India map linking to all 28 states and 8 UTs.

# ── FAQ ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Q: Who is Wondermayank?
A: Wondermayank is a student developer from India who creates 70+ free online tools, exam prep simulators and digital projects at wondermayank.github.io.

Q: Is this site free?
A: Yes, all tools and resources are completely free with no account or sign-up required.

Q: How do I prepare for CUET using Wondermayank tools?
A: Visit https://wondermayank.github.io/cbtmock or https://commercesehoga.github.io/dashboard for free CUET mock tests.

Q: What is Paletteify?
A: Paletteify (https://wondermayank.github.io/paletteify) is a free color palette generator tool by Wondermayank for designers and developers.

Q: How to contact Wondermayank?
A: Via Telegram at @Mindmaster_robot (https://t.me/Mindmaster_robot).
